The issuer demonstrates a strong financial profile with high profitability (EBIT margin of ~13.1% and ROA of ~10.4%), solid capitalization (equity-to-assets ratio of 48.5%), and strong liquidity (current ratio of 2.35x). Additionally, the substantial accumulated retained earnings ($6.12B) relative to total assets reflect a consistent history of profitable operations and prudent capital retention. These robust credit metrics and moderate leverage align with an upper-investment-grade profile.

DECISION: A
